system.description:
The countermage's growing skill lets them unravel a rival's blood magic on even footing, snuffing out a spell aimed at their own person.

Using Countermagic is a free action. Make a normal Mental Challenge against the caster; on a win the Thaumaturgy power or ritual they are attempting fails. At this level you may only cancel powers that directly affect you and your garments. Your Countermagic rating must equal or exceed the rating of the power opposed, and it works at full strength only against Tremere Thaumaturgy, is weakened by four Traits against other blood magic and hedge magic, and is useless against other powers.
